Expectations for the memorable week
This section explains the plain rules

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Purpose: This section sets the shared rules for handling companion animal travel requests at Aurelia Skyways so travelers receive clear, steady guidance.

The desk must answer requests promptly and with respect, and staff should record any approved service change in the desk ledger before the trip is confirmed. When a traveler asks about a reptile, the desk must provide the required guidance and avoid adding extra promises or assumptions. <<FACT F078>> Staff should then confirm that the rest of the booking details match the accepted travel plan and that the traveler understands any handling notes shared by the department. If a traveler changes a record, the update should be entered at once so crews can rely on the latest information.

The desk must also give practical support for larger animals and explain the usual steps in simple language. <<FACT F057>> After that, staff should review crate, carrier, and cabin or hold conditions as needed, and should flag any issue that could affect safety, comfort, or timely boarding. If a traveler brings a pet such as Coco, the desk should treat the request with the same care as any other companion animal case and keep the instructions consistent from one contact to the next. Clear notes help the flight crew, the ground team, and the traveler work from the same plan.

If the rules cannot be met, staff should say so directly and offer the nearest safe alternative within policy. The goal is to protect the animal, support the traveler, and avoid confusion at the airport.

For any uncertain case or record correction, contact the senior coordinator through the normal desk channel.
